text_en: Then God spoke all these words:
text_cn: 天主训示以下这一切话说：

text_en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery;
text_cn: “我是上主你的天主，是我领你出了埃及地、奴隶之所。

text_en: you shall have no other gods before me.
text_cn: 除我之外，你不可有别的神。

text_en: You shall not make for yourself an idol, whether in the form of anything that is in heaven above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
text_cn: 不可为你制造任何仿佛天上、或地上、或地下水中之物的雕像。

text_en: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I the Lord your God am a jealous God, punishing children for the iniquity of parents, to the third and the fourth generation of those who reject me,
text_cn: 不可叩拜这些像，也不可敬奉，因为我，上主，你的天主是忌邪的天主；凡恼恨我的，我要追讨他们的罪，从父亲直到儿子，甚至三代四代的子孙。

text_en: but showing steadfast love to the thousandth generation of those who love me and keep my commandments.
text_cn: 凡爱慕我和遵守我诫命的，我要对他们施仁慈，直到他们的千代子孙。

text_en: You shall not make wrongful use of the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not acquit anyone who misuses his name.
text_cn: 不可妄呼上主你天主的名；因为凡妄呼他名的人，上主决不让他们免受惩罚。

text_en: Remember the sabbath day, and keep it holy.
text_cn: 应记住安息日，守为圣日。

text_en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.
text_cn: 六天应该劳作，作你一切的事；

text_en: But the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God; you shall not do any work—you, your son or your daughter, your male or female slave, your livestock, or the alien resident in your towns.
text_cn: 但第七天是为恭敬上主你的天主当守的安息日；你自己、连你的儿女、你的仆婢、你的牲口，以及在你中间居住的外方人，都不可作任何工作。

text_en: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but rested the seventh day; therefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day and consecrated it.
text_cn: 因为上主在六天内造了天地、海洋和其中一切，但第七天休息了，因此上主祝福了安息日，也定为圣日。

text_en: Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
text_cn: 应孝敬你的父亲和你的母亲，好使你在上主你的天主赐给你的地方，延年益寿。

text_en: You shall not murder.
text_cn: 不可杀人。

text_en: You shall not commit adultery.
text_cn: 不可奸淫。

text_en: You shall not steal.
text_cn: 不可偷盗。

text_en: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
text_cn: 不可作假见证，害你的近人。

text_en: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house; you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or male or female slave, or ox, or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.
text_cn: 不可贪你近人的房舍。不可贪恋你近人的妻子、仆人、婢女、牛驴及你近人的一切。”

text_en: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking, they were afraid and trembled and stood at a distance,
text_cn: 众百姓看见打雷、打闪、吹角、冒烟的山，都战兢害怕，远远站着，

text_en: and said to Moses, “You speak to us, and we will listen; but do not let God speak to us, or we will die. ”
text_cn: 对梅瑟说：“你同我们说话吧！我们定要听从，不要天主同我们说话，免得我们死亡。”

text_en: Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid; for God has come only to test you and to put the fear of him upon you so that you do not sin. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟回答百姓说：“不要害怕！因为天主降临是为试探你们，使你们在他面前常怀敬畏之情，不致犯罪。”

text_en: Then the people stood at a distance, while Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was.
text_cn: 百姓远远站着，梅瑟却走近天主所在的浓云中。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses: Thus you shall say to the Israelites: “You have seen for yourselves that I spoke with you from heaven.
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“你这样训示以色列子民说：你们亲自见过我从天上同你们说了话。

text_en: You shall not make gods of silver alongside me, nor shall you make for yourselves gods of gold.
text_cn: 为此，你们决不可制造金银神像，同我放在一起；你们万不可做。

text_en: You need make for me only an altar of earth and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your offerings of well-being, your sheep and your oxen; in every place where I cause my name to be remembered I will come to you and bless you.
text_cn: 你应用土为我筑一祭坛，在上面祭献你的全燔祭与和平祭，以及你的牛羊；凡在我叫你称颂我名的地方，我必到你那里祝福你。

text_en: But if you make for me an altar of stone, do not build it of hewn stones; for if you use a chisel upon it you profane it.
text_cn: 你若用石头为我筑一祭坛，不可用打成方块的石头建筑，因为在石头上动用了你的刀凿，就把石头亵渎了。

text_en: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, so that your nakedness may not be exposed on it. ”
text_cn: 你不可沿着台阶登我的祭坛，免得暴露你的裸体。
